License.MigrationTitle: Why am I being asked to reconnect?
License.MigrationBody: We changed how Patreon subscriptions are verified, so activations made before the change no longer validate. Reconnecting your account once puts it right. This is not a new charge and not a price change: your Patreon subscription is untouched, you will not be billed again, and you keep your installation slots. Only the authorisation is renewed.

Hub.SettingHint: Name of the journal opened as a game menu via the J key, the sidebar button or the scene control. If it doesn't exist, it's created automatically the first time the GM opens it.

Hub.Created: Created the journal "{name}" as the Velvet menu.
Hub.Subtitle: Everything the table needs, in one place.
Hub.WelcomeContent:
This journal is your campaign menu. Use the tabs above:

  • Dashboard — create cards with images or videos and link them to scenes, actors, macros or pages. You can also drag documents straight in.
  • NPCs — drag actors from the sidebar to build the portrait gallery.
  • Quests — track active, completed and failed quests with objectives and progress.
  • Pages — the classic journal, with all of Foundry's power.

Open it anytime with the J key.

Atlas.MapImageHint: PNG, JPG or WEBP. For example, the Phandalin town plan or the campaign region.
Atlas.MapParentHint: If you pick a parent (a big city), this map is nested under it in the index.
Atlas.PinMapLinkHint: If you pick a map, clicking this pin navigates to it (e.g. from the region to Phandalin) instead of opening the card.
Atlas.PinHiddenHint: Hidden pins are only visible to the GM and owners.
Atlas.Hint: Press the pin button (or double-click the map) to add a point of interest · drag a pin to move it
Atlas.ModalHint: Drag actors or items (even from compendia) here to add them as NPCs or merchandise.
Atlas.Duplicate: That document is already linked to this place.
Atlas.EmptyHint: Create a map (a Phandalin town plan, a region, a tavern floor plan) and mark its places with pins.

Dashboard.EmptyHint: Create cards with images or videos, or drag scenes, actors, macros and journal entries here to link them.
Dashboard.OpenMissing: The linked document no longer exists.

Cards.Title: Title
Cards.Subtitle: Subtitle
Cards.CategoryHint: Cards sharing a section name are grouped together on the dashboard. Leave empty for no section.
Cards.MediaHint: PNG, JPG, WEBP, GIF, WEBM or MP4. Videos loop; sound is toggled from the card.
Cards.LinkHint: Drag a scene, actor, item, macro, roll table, playlist or page here. A scene opens, a macro runs, a roll table draws, a playlist plays/stops, a page jumps to it, anything else opens its sheet.
Cards.UrlHint: If set, the card opens this URL in the browser.

Npcs.Hint: Drag actors from the sidebar to add them. Drag a portrait onto the canvas to place its token, or over another to reorder.
Npcs.EmptyHint: Drag actors from the sidebar or a compendium to create their portrait.
Npcs.Duplicate: That actor is already in the gallery.
Npcs.LocationHint: Attach this character to one of your Atlas maps so they can be filtered by place (e.g. Vallaki, Barovia, Ravenloft).
Npcs.PortraitHint: Optional custom art for the dossier card. Falls back to the actor's own image if left empty.
Npcs.BioHint: Supports Markdown (headings, **bold**, lists...), HTML and @UUID[...] document links.
Npcs.NoBioHint: No notes yet. Click Edit to write this character's dossier.
Npcs.NoViewPermission: You don't have permission to view that character's sheet.
